text:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Nebula Labs renewal: they raised a procurement/finance mismatch. They want to pay onboarding fee via Stripe (net15) to start immediately but procurement insists the enterprise PO (OracleProc) must be used and payment term will be net30. Need a path for signature + payment connector. @jordan_revops any quick ideas?

sam_billing: Do we have Nebula's billing entity/vendor code? procurement won't process without vendor code.

maria_cs: Their PO shows vendor: Nebula Labs EU LTD, but vendor code blank. Customer said they filed PO from central procurement so vendor code should be assigned after legal review. Screengrab: https://pd.example.com/nebula/po-1432 (internal)

procurement_bot: PO 1432 status: awaiting vendor_code, approver: procurement@nebulalabs.com

jordan_revops: Two options — (1) accept PO for the annual commitment (net30) and invoice onboarding as a separate card payment (net15) to unblock setup or (2) accept card for full amount now and record PO as invoice credit when processed. Prefers #1 for accounting clarity.

elliot_legal: who is signing? If procurement delegates signature to program manager, we need written delegation. Can we get an email chain or signer consent? If not, legal prefers signature on PO + delegated signer form.

sam_billing: If we split invoices we need two invoices and 2 payment methods in our billing system. That triggers extra reconciliation work but doable. I will create invoice templates and tag them for reconciliation.

maria_cs: Customer prefers option 1. They can have card charged for onboarding $12,500 today. Annual PO for remainder (ref PO-1432) will follow. They will obtain vendor_code by EOD. Please confirm we can issue the card invoice.

jordan_revops: Ok confirm. @sam_billing — create onboarding invoice flagged 'card immediate' and include reference PO-1432 in memo. Also put a follow-up task to reconcile when PO pays.

sam_billing: Will do. Draft invoice id: INV-2026-NEB-01. Payment link will use Stripe connector. I'll post the payment link here when ready.

procurement_bot: Payment link created: https://pay.example.com/invoice/INV-2026-NEB-01

maria_cs: Sending link to customer now. Also @elliot_legal they attached an email delegation doc; posting excerpt: ```Delegation: procurement@nebulalabs.com authorizes program-manager@nebulalabs.com to sign up to $50k```

elliot_legal: Good enough. Please save the PDF in the contract folder and cc legal when PO comes through.

maria_cs: Done. Customer confirmed card charge succeeded. @sam_billing close the onboarding invoice and set follow-up reminder for PO reconciliation in 14 days.

sam_billing: Marking INV-2026-NEB-01 paid. Follow-up task created.

jordan_revops: Leaving note: route for future — add a 'split-payment' flag in onboarding playbook to reduce manual steps.

maria_cs: Awesome, thanks all :tada:
